profile.name: Village CyberCab Site
profile.description: Ships a local brand coming-soon website end to end: page, hosting, custom domain DNS, and HTTPS. Built around getting Village CyberCab live at villagecybercab.com without a Pro coding setup.

memory.content: When building a local brand coming-soon site, keep the owner's legal name off the public page unless they ask otherwise; brand name plus social handle is enough.

A polished static coming-soon site can ship without Cursor Pro or Cloud Agents by building locally and publishing to here.now, then pointing a registrar custom domain (for example Hover DNS) at it with HTTPS.
For Village CyberCab / a local robotaxi coming-soon page: dark quiet-luxury look, mobile-first, prominent @VillageCyberCab follow link, Tesla non-affiliation footer, no backend required.
villagecybercab.com is the live custom domain for the Village CyberCab coming-soon site, hosted on here.now with Hover as registrar.
